prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night in a secret 1930s basement, the camera low beneath the delivery tray of a huge black iron printing press with a simple face painted on its side and a coal firebox in its belly glowing red hot: sheets of blank green paper money with no printing on them spit out of the rollers straight towards us, filling the near foreground, edges lit red. Behind the press, off-centre, a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a gold chain, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, his shirt-sleeves rolled up, waistcoat, sweat running down his face heaves a shovel of coal into the open firebox, his real-skinned face lit red from below. Emerald lamps hang in the dark above; flour sifts down through the cracks of the wooden ceiling. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the open firebox and the notes catching its glow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
